arguments.query: SELECT tier,count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY tier
SELECT status,count(*),min(order_ts),max(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT payment_status,method,count(*) FROM payments GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT o.status,count(*) n,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id AND payment_status='ok')) paid,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id)) shipped,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL)) deliv,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id)) refd FROM orders o GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_items)
SELECT o.status,count(*) n,count(p.order_id) paid,sum(p.amount_twd) amt FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status='ok' GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status,count(DISTINCT s.order_id) shipped,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL THEN s.order_id END) deliv FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status,count(DISTINCT r.order_id),sum(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1

SELECT count(*), sum(p.amount_twd), sum(i.t) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status='ok' JOIN (SELECT order_id, sum(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 t FROM order_items GROUP BY 1) i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE c.tier='S' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01'

SELECT sum(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.tier='S' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01'
